decisions.rationale: duplicate_row_rate is 0.0 across row_count 10760, so no exact-duplicate rows exist in bronze and no deduplication logic is needed.

purpose: silver_runways cleans the bronze ourairports_runways capture so downstream analytics and airport-infrastructure lookups can access runway attributes (length, width, surface, lighting, heading, and displaced thresholds) joined to airports via airport_ref and airport_ident.
usage: Join on airport_ref or airport_ident to associate runways with airports, use id as the primary key for row-level lookups, and explicitly handle nulls on the latitude/longitude/elevation/heading fields (roughly 22%-28% null) and on the displaced-threshold fields (88%-90% null) rather than assuming they are populated.
limitations: Cleanup did not resolve the high null rates on le_/he_ latitude, longitude, elevation, heading, and displaced-threshold columns (22%-90% null) or normalize the free-form, inconsistent surface and ident text values (surface distinct_count 239; le_ident/he_ident samples like '-12', '.', '-'); no duplicate-row cleanup was required since duplicate_row_rate was 0.0.
